According to the directions from the Eye of Graeae, one of the fragments of his power is located behind Zapolyarny Palace, where the Tsar's White Birch grows...

#### Talk to the Eye of Graeae

**Paimon:** It's so cold out there... The train's definitely much cozier...

**Eye of Graeae:** That is precisely why the trains exist. Trekking long distances through such bitter cold would hardly be good for anyone's health.

**Eye of Graeae:** Perhaps that, too, was my creator's original purpose in establishing it... After all, this land of ice and snow is hardly a place fit for humans to survive.

**Paimon:** Your creator...? Ah, could that be the strange woman we ran into earlier?

- **Traveler:** How rude! What do you mean, "strange woman"!?

**Paimon:** Paimon definitely doesn't mean the strange woman you're talking about right now!

**Paimon:** ...You know, the one who appeared in that mumbly-jumbly town with the firebird, and in that castle full of Snegovik. Paimon remembers her name was Ak...

**Eye of Graeae:** Miss Aksinya, yes. Judging from the memories I have recovered so far, she was once a member of the Belyi Tsar's research organization, Hvergelmir...

**Eye of Graeae:** She created me so that I might... guide a certain mighty power, and create a "Tomorrow" — a world where no one would ever suffer again...

**Eye of Graeae:** A land that has cast aside envy, hatred, and selfish desire. A "Court of Bliss" held aloft by the hands of all living beings. Thus...

**Eye of Graeae:** "Thus shall a radiant world descend, where there will be no distinction between human and human, nor between human and god."

**Paimon:** A world where there's no distinction between humans and gods? Hmm... Paimon can't even imagine how you'd make that happen...

**Eye of Graeae:** "A pure world of mankind, where gods need not wield divine power, and humans need not rely on gods."

**Eye of Graeae:** ...That is the outcome of the plan, as I remember it.

**Eye of Graeae:** But as for how it was to be accomplished... I'm sorry, but I do not know the full scope of the final plan. To the plan as a whole, I was nothing more than a "tool" within it.

**Paimon:** Oh, Paimon gets it! Goggles is like a crafting bench. It can craft all kinds of amazing things, but a crafting bench doesn't run around eating up its own materials.

**Eye of Graeae:** That is a very apt analogy. However, if I may, Miss Paimon, in present-day Snezhnaya, alchemy is not an officially supported field of study...

**Paimon:** R-Right... But, well, we're on our own train, so...

**Eye of Graeae:** ...But should I truly seek out the final power?

**Eye of Graeae:** What if, after obtaining that last portion of power, the memories that return are not the ones I wished to recover? What should I do then?

**Eye of Graeae:** What if... What if that's the only reason I was created, the purpose I was destined for...?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Then don't decide yet. Wait until you remember.

**Paimon:** Yeah! It's definitely not good to decide when you don't know anything yet. No matter what, you've gotta remember everything first!

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** What's wrong with a crafting bench wanting to craft!?

**Paimon:** Exactly! And if anyone's to blame, it's whoever misused the crafting bench!

**Paimon:** Wah, this is all your fault... Now Paimon can't stop imagining a crafting bench going "huff, huff" like some kind of dog!

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** Anyway... Goggles has helped us out a lot! Even if that wasn't what Goggles was originally created for, Goggles has still been really useful to us!

- **Traveler:** When that time comes, just come back to us.

**Eye of Graeae:** ...Is that so?

**Paimon:** Besides, we already talked about all the things we're going to do together when you get your body back! Warming up by the fire, having snowball fights, running around on the ice fields... We promised!

**Eye of Graeae:** Yes. I look forward to... adventuring together with you both after I recover my body.

**Eye of Graeae:** Though I have thought this countless times throughout our journey... I am truly glad that you were the one to bring me out of that place, and that I was able to meet you both.

**Eye of Graeae:** The final power... all the answers are there. At the final resting place of the previous Tsar of Ice — the one known as the Belyi Tsar...

**Eye of Graeae:** I have marked the location on your map.

**Paimon:** So that is...

**Eye of Graeae:** Yes. That's where we're going... The Belyi Tsar's private palace outside Snezhnograd.

**Eye of Graeae:** Pale Crown Palace.

**Eye of Graeae:** There, the graceful Snegurochka once played the gusli in the palace royal hall, while waterborn fae sang along to the ethereal melody, chanting the name of the king who ruled the snowfields.

**Eye of Graeae:** Valiant Volkodlak clashed endlessly before the throne, vying for the Tsar's favor, while Domovoy searched far and wide for rare treasures and riches, all to fill the palace vault.

**Paimon:** Whoa... T-Treasure vault?

**Eye of Graeae:** Yes. Though by now, I'm afraid it has long since been emptied.

**Eye of Graeae:** They say... that was where the great king showed mercy. There, he accepted humankind and allowed them to come before him...

**Eye of Graeae:** To help the frail, pitiful humans of that time carve out a place of their own amid the ice and snow, the flame of Kresnik was first kindled in that palace, then spread far and wide.

**Eye of Graeae:** And so, unlike in the days of the Pale Star's royal court, this eternally frozen land no longer belonged to the fae alone. It became a land shared by humans and fae...

**Eye of Graeae:** And he renamed it Snezhnaya.

**Paimon:** Oh... So that's how Snezhnaya came to be. Paimon always thought the Tsaritsa founded it...

**Paimon:** Hmm, how does Goggles know so much about this place?

**Eye of Graeae:** Of course. I was created here, in a hidden chamber within this palace...

**Eye of Graeae:** The place we mentioned before, Hvergelmir... Though even that is only one corner of the palace's shadow.

**Paimon:** Oh, wow... If this palace was so impressive, why does it feel so cold and deserted now?

**Eye of Graeae:** Because five hundred years ago, the Belyi Tsar died fighting the Abyss and the tides of beasts. His remains were brought back here...

**Eye of Graeae:** And after he was laid to rest, part of his body became the "Tsar's White Birch." Since then, the Tsaritsa has ruled Snezhnaya from Zapolyarny Palace, and no one has returned here since.

**Paimon:** So... where we're going is actually the Belyi Tsar's... tomb?

**Eye of Graeae:** Yes, Miss Paimon. The Belyi Tsar's tomb — but also the place where I was created.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Wait, this isn't against the rules, is it?

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** We're not going to get caught and end up on a wanted list, are we?

##### Shared continuation

**Eye of Graeae:** ...The authorities advise against entering without permission. But officially, it is not strictly forbidden.

**Paimon:** Not strictly forbidden? Then that means we're strictly allowed to sneak in!

**Eye of Graeae:** Then again... getting put on a wanted list could be interesting.

**Paimon:** Whoa, no thanks... Okay, Paimon knows what to do. If we get caught by some Snezhnayan guards...

**Paimon:** Paimon will just say the guiding mechanism sent us the wrong way and we got lost! Getting lost isn't illegal, right? Yep, that's our story.

**Paimon:** But... the train tracks are broken. What are we gonna do?

**Eye of Graeae:** It's all right. That route was only ever meant to mislead people. It was never the real way into the Pale Crown Palace.

**Eye of Graeae:** Think of it as a marker, telling ordinary pilgrims and those visiting in remembrance that they should go no farther.

**Eye of Graeae:** If we really mean to cross over, we'll need to find... the mechanism that activates the "hidden tracks."

**Eye of Graeae:** I can sense it. The mechanism that summons the "hidden tracks" should be up on that tower.

**Eye of Graeae:** But the tower appears to be encircled by the "Tsar's White Birch." We'll have to find another way in...

**Paimon:** Whoa... Paimon had no idea all this was underneath that giant tree...

**Paimon:** Is that... a palace?

**Eye of Graeae:** That's odd... Why, all of a sudden...

**Paimon:** Goggles, what's wrong?

**Eye of Graeae:** I told you before... that I could sense the power that once belonged to me had been split into three parts. One of them was hidden away in a deeper darkness beyond my perception.

**Eye of Graeae:** But now, maybe because we're closer, I can feel it... The power I couldn't sense before is right here...

**Paimon:** Here?

**Eye of Graeae:** Yes. It is right here... within the Pale Crown Palace before us...

**Paimon:** The Pale Crown Palace?

**Eye of Graeae:** Yes. It is the Belyi Tsar's private palace outside Snezhnograd.

**Paimon:** Goggles, you're amazing! Is there any train you can't drive?

**Eye of Graeae:** ...Not exactly. For some reason, the trains currently running in Snezhnaya only keep their power systems, leaving no room for remote control.

**Eye of Graeae:** These early prototypes, though, still have control interfaces...

**Paimon:** Oh... Is... that... so...

#### Enter the strange space

Friends, we were created for a single moment, 
To call back those dreams flickering on the verge of extinction, to...

To...?

- **Traveler:** (Hmm... Where... am I?)

- **Traveler:** (Wait... wasn't I just... on the train?)

**???:** Izmaylov... Izmaylov. Hah, spacing out again, are we? We need to keep watch on the thing inside the egg at all times, remember?

**Izmaylov:** I wasn't spacing out... And the Proto-Man is in a highly stable state. Even in the gloom of the Font of the Shadow Realm, he shines as brilliantly as a pearl.

**???:** Then you weren't spacing out. You were worried.

**Izmaylov:** You are right, Azazel. There is too much to think about.

**Azazel:** There is no need for such concern. Your teacher, Miss Aksinya, remained quite composed upon hearing of His Majesty the Tsar's passing... Oh, are you worried about something else?

**Izmaylov:** The newly ascended Tsaritsa. It is her attitude that concerns me...

**Azazel:** Her attitude toward those fae nobles wallowing in Mora and decadence? I doubt it's anything favorable.

**Izmaylov:** I mean her attitude toward Hvergelmir...

**Izmaylov:** After all, our research has crossed into forbidden territory. The only reason we were allowed to continue before was His Majesty's tacit approval and protection. But our new Tsaritsa...

**Izmaylov:** Well, I've heard certain things.

**Azazel:** What kind of things?

**Izmaylov:** They're planning to ban anything related to alchemy. Hvergelmir has plenty of bio-alchemy projects, so it's obvious those would be shut down. And if that happens...

**Izmaylov:** His Majesty's final aspiration will never be realized.

**Azazel:** Perhaps that would be for the best. Have you forgotten what happened during the last experiment? And besides, His Majesty, in the end, also... Never mind...

**Izmaylov:** ...You are right, Azazel. But I still need to think this through.

**Azazel:** Don't dwell on it, Izmaylov. It's not our call to make. Besides... the higher-ups are meeting today.

**Azazel:** Once they've decided what to do, they'll inform us.

- **Traveler:** (Is this... a Shadow Realm? Paimon and the Eye of Graeae are gone...)

- **Traveler:** (...There are two people up ahead. Maybe I should try talking to them.)

**Izmaylov:** Hmm?

**Azazel:** Something wrong, my dear Izmaylov? You'd be even better company if you didn't get distracted so easily.

**Izmaylov:** *sigh* I keep feeling like someone's watching us... But when I look back, there's no one there.

**Azazel:** Hah. Come now, Izmaylov. Maybe you should keep your eyes on the things that matter.

**Azazel:** Speaking of which, Mr. Koshchei seems to have left in a hurry and forgotten to close his office door. Well, never mind. Once we're done recording the data, I'll close it for him.

- **Traveler:** (They can't see me... That's strange. Something feels off, like I don't quite belong here.)

- **Traveler:** (But I'm not feeling too uncomfortable. Hmm... Maybe I should take a look around first...)

**Izmaylov:** Strange...

**Azazel:** Stop staring at nothing. We still have a lot to do...

#### Investigate the strange space

**Message:** (A note, written in an elegant hand...)

**Message:** "I will be returning to the House of Hesperides for the next few days, so I'll leave the cat in your care. I can hardly trust the others with her, given how absorbed they become in their experiments."

**Message:** "I am sure my colleague Koshchei shares my respect for living things and will remember to feed my Lara... The key and specially prepared cat food are on your desk."

**Message:** "...And remember, my Lara only eats from her bowl. Please don't scatter her food on the floor. She won't eat anything off the floor."

**Message:** "P.S. If I find that my cat has not been properly fed, or that she has somehow grown parts from another animal, I will find out who is responsible. — Pavlina"

#### Investigate the next room

#### Read the notes sealed in Prime Ice

**Someone's Notes:** (A note, written in a cold, stiff hand with almost no variation...)

**Someone's Notes:** "...The prisoners used as experimental material have already been handed over to Alvis. There is no doubt that the results of that experiment were 'incorrect.'"

**Someone's Notes:** "But is that what humans... Is that what loveless fae should seek as 'love'? Perhaps the Snegovik, incomplete in spirit as they are, truly could make use of this technology..."

**Someone's Notes:** "To gain the 'love' they lacked from the beginning. Just as... just as 'he' told me, dreams that are too grand have no meaning. Perhaps..."

**Someone's Notes:** "Perhaps 'he' was right. That power... That power should have been ours from the start, as compensation. It was never meant to belong to Aksinya's aberrant dream."

**Someone's Notes:** "...I will stop here before Alvis 'accidentally' comes across this again and causes more trouble."

#### Find the source of the cat cries

**Cat:** Meow... Meow...

- **Traveler:** (It looks like it's starving... But according to what Pavlina said earlier, it won't eat unless the food is placed in its bowl...)

- **Traveler:** (Too bad. There doesn't seem to be a food bowl nearby...)

##### Shared continuation

- **Traveler:** (...Looks like nothing I put there will work for this ritual. Maybe there's another meaning behind the words in that note.)

- **Traveler:** ("Separated, everything is not the cause. For everything to be everything, what was divided must be gathered back into one?")

- **Traveler:** (I should try... combining something together.)

"Cast off the soul of the past, and it shall no longer be bound by the hidden veins of the planet." "Cast off the will of the past, and it shall no longer be watched by the gaze above." "Cast off the body of the past, and it shall no longer be worn away by the toil and turmoil of the mortal world."

Following the note's instructions, you grind the yellow crystal and Kresnik Kristall ore into powder and add them to the reagent bottle.
Then...
A new substance begins to form.

- **Traveler:** (A strange reagent... Even when I hold it in my hand, it doesn't feel like it weighs anything. Is it because...)

- **Traveler:** (This substance, by nature, "transcends" ordinary concepts?)

"It worked... This reagent has the exact same properties as the (...) that once reduced Kitezhgrad to ruin."
You hear a piercing voice echo through the room.
"This is the way to transcendence in this world — restoration and reversal."
"All 'humans' came from (...). With this power in my hands, I can become like them. I can create... I can even command it all..."

"'He' didn't lie to me. The man in the egg... 'He' was right. I just need a way. I need to get 'Him,' even one fragment would be enough..."
"Your Majesty, this should be mine, shouldn't it? I, Alvis, deserve this much!"
"'His' power is perfect. 'He' is the answer I've spent so long searching for. I simply must have 'him'..."

**Vsevolod:** The concoction, the concoction...

#### Go to the second floor and search

**Aksinya:** They'll be absolutely stunned to learn that I can upload your consciousness here, fully intact, using ancient Hyperborean technology.

**Aksinya:** Impressive technology indeed. Very well. Let's call this lightweight, portable device the "Eye of Graeae."

**???:** ...That's what these goggles are called? But they're blue... Uh, anyway, this feels really weird. I can't feel my arms or legs at all.

**???:** Now that I'm inside this tiny little device, I can barely feel... my own body.

- **Traveler:** (Is that Aksinya... from the past? And the one speaking to her is... the Eye of Graeae from the past?)

**Aksinya:** That's to be expected. Your consciousness may have been uploaded into these goggles, but your body is still what sustains your power and your existence.

**Aksinya:** After all, your body is the true key to opening the new world.

**Aksinya:** As that "key," you are already a perfect work of creation. If only... if only we could have gone further...

**Eye of Graeae:** But His Majesty... What a pity.

**Eye of Graeae:** Part of my body once belonged to His Majesty. Sometimes, through fragments of his consciousness, I can see what he once saw. That's how I know...

**Eye of Graeae:** If all goes smoothly, you will carry on his will and bring his grand design to completion... He would surely be pleased.

**Aksinya:** "Only you can make me laugh so freely, Aksinya." That's what he would say, and he would mean every word. Not like when he speaks to that "Professor," with all those hollow pleasantries.

**Aksinya:** A "Court Jester" gives everything to bring joy to her lord. That is her duty.

**Eye of Graeae:** "Court Jester" was merely a nominal title His Majesty gave you so you could come and go from the palace. It was only meant to keep people from resenting a human for being in His favor. You don't have to...

**Aksinya:** I don't see anything wrong with the title. There's nothing laughable about it. Even now, it still has its uses.

**Aksinya:** Perhaps I could use it to gain entry to Zapolyarny Palace and speak with the newly crowned Tsaritsa... Though by the time I came to court, she had long since departed...

**Aksinya:** Perhaps she will understand His Majesty's will...

**Eye of Graeae:** Yes, Aksinya.

**Aksinya:** I should show you to my colleagues, just as you are now. Perhaps then, they'll admit that every line of research has its worth. At the very least, Alvis will stand by me.

**Aksinya:** Perhaps they will help me carry this great cause forward...

**Aksinya:** Though I know our ideals do not align, all differences will ultimately return to a single path. In the end, true understanding will come.

**Aksinya:** They will help me, won't they?

**Eye of Graeae:** ...

**Eye of Graeae:** ...Yes, Aksinya, they will.

**Aksinya:** Yeah.

**Aksinya:** This is the only thing I can do for him, and the only meaning my life has ever had.

**Aksinya:** I must have the "Proto-Man," have "you"... No, I beg "you." Please, take the place His Majesty was meant to hold in the original plan...

**Aksinya:** Please, become the ruler of this planet.

**Aksinya:** Ah... For a grand undertaking like this, why should I need anyone else's approval or support? Maybe I can carry on the final experiment on my own...

**Eye of Graeae:** ...

A grand vision, yes. But then what?

**Aksinya:** No... How could you...? Can't you see...?

**Aksinya:** This is... such a terrible betrayal... Alvis, Koshchei, Pavlina...

**Aksinya:** You've forgotten... why we came here. Forgotten that grand, radiant vision...

**Aksinya:** You’ve forgotten... the grace he gave us, the glory he granted us. You...
